title: MarketTable
description: Shape of one market file, data/market/{id}.json (p1-03): where the exchange is, the docking rules every sale is judged by, and the price rule of every mineral it buys (design doc p1-03 section 3: banded saturation with lazy recovery). THE NUMBERS BELONG TO THE DESIGNER. PUBLIC data kind (ADR-0015): the whole file is part of the client copy - the client reads the geometry and docking rules for display and the listing constants for the 'expected proceeds' preview, but the CURRENT saturation and price reach it only through MARKET_STATE. Hiding an unlisted mineral's name and value on screen is a presentation rule (UI-06), like p1-02's 'M undiscovered'; mineral names and rarity are already public in MINERAL. Price rule (integers only, every division rounds toward zero on non-negative operands): floor_band = ceil((100 - price_floor_pct) / price_drop_pct_per_band); band(s) = min(s div band_kg, floor_band); price(b) = base_price_cr_per_kg * max(price_floor_pct, 100 - b * price_drop_pct_per_band) div 100; a sale of q kg walks the bands from the current saturation s (spec p1-03 section 4.2a). Recovery: effective(t) = max(0, s - recovery_kg * (floor(t / I) - floor(as_of / I))), I = recovery_interval_s * tick_hz. pricing_version is bound by a golden test to this file's normalised content: changing any price number without bumping it fails the build (spec p1-03 I-90). Boot-time checks beyond this schema (all boot failures, spec p1-03 section 4.8): star_system_id is a loaded star system; pricing_version starts with id + '@'; every mineral has exactly one listing and every listing's mineral_id exists; |position| + radius_m + dock_range_from_surface_m <= soft_boundary_radius_m; the docking zone overlaps no deposit's mining zone; every listing's floor price base * price_floor_pct div 100 >= 1; floor_band * band_kg <= 2147483647 for every listing. Guaranteed by this schema rather than checked at boot (spec p1-03 section 4.8): whole seconds times an integer tick_hz are whole ticks, and base_price_cr_per_kg <= 1000000 keeps 2147483647 * base_price_cr_per_kg <= 9007199254740991 - a change that raises that maximum must recompute this bound. 단위 접미사 규약: 수치 필드 이름이 단위로 끝난다 (_m, _mps, _s, _kg, _cr, _cr_per_kg, _pct). **_kg·_cr·_cr_per_kg·_pct 필드는 정수다** (primitives MassKg·CreditAmount). _s 필드도 정수이고 tick_hz 를 곱해 정수 tick 이 되어야 한다(서버 기동 검증).

id.description: Market id - what SELL_MINERAL.market_id names and MINERAL_SOLD records.

pricing_version.description: '{market id}@{n}'. Recorded on every MINERAL_SOLD so a sale can be recomputed with the rule it was priced by after the numbers change. Bump n whenever any number under rules (price part) or listings changes.

dock_range_from_surface_m.description: Docked iff |ship - market|^2 <= (radius_m + this)^2 on the authoritative f64 state at the START of the tick.

max_ship_speed_mps.description: Slow enough iff |ship velocity|^2 <= this^2, same instant.

sell_cooldown_s.description: Per actor, separate from the mining cooldown. Started only by an ACCEPTED sale; not persisted (like the mining cooldown).

base_price_cr_per_kg.description: Price per kg in band 0 (saturation below band_kg). The maximum 1000000 is load-bearing: (2^31-1) kg * 1000000 cr/kg ~= 2.15e15 < 2^53-1, so no sale's proceeds can exceed CreditAmount. Raising it requires recomputing that bound (spec p1-03 section 4.8).

band_kg.description: Saturation width of one price band.

recovery_kg.description: Saturation removed at every world tick that is a multiple of recovery_interval_s * tick_hz.
